## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Agent Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- `instructions` is required: a Markdown document with optional `summary` frontmatter and a non-empty body, at most 51,200 bytes. The deprecated `description` field is still accepted; if both are sent they must match exactly.
- `agent_name` must not contain `@` or be `general` / `explore` (reserved by built-in agents), and must be unique within its scope (account-wide or one team); violations return `InvalidParameter`.
- `card_url` must be an absolute `http`/`https` URL with a host. When an execution environment for the agent is online, the server fetches the agent card through it (a `card_url` with no path gets `/.well-known/agent-card.json` appended) and rejects a card that is not valid JSON or declares no A2A 1.x interface with protocol binding `JSONRPC` or `HTTP+JSON`; an unreachable card, a non-2xx response, or no online environment does not block the call.
- `auth_type=bearer` sends `auth_config.token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; `auth_type=api_key` sends `auth_config.api_key` in the header named by `auth_config.header`; with `none` or an empty value no shared credential header is sent.
- Each `environments` entry must be `cloud` or the ID of a BYOC runner that is account-scoped or belongs to one of the caller's teams; duplicates are dropped and an empty string is rejected. Omitted or empty means all environments.
- Creating into a team (`team_id > 0`) requires the caller to belong to that team; only the account owner or an admin may create at account scope (`team_id=0`).
- A new agent starts with `status=enabled`.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Automation Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- Omit `team_id` or send `0` for a personal rule. A team rule requires the caller to be a member of that team; account owners and admins get no exemption.
- A rule's scope is fixed at creation: Update Automation rule rejects any `team_id` that differs from the stored value. Create a new rule to run the same task under another scope.
- `cron_expr` is required even when only other triggers are used; send a valid expression with `schedule_trigger_enabled=false`.
- `cron_expr` is evaluated in `timezone` if provided, else the caller's member timezone, else the account timezone, else `Asia/Shanghai`.
- `http_post_trigger_enabled=true` creates an enabled HTTP POST trigger. `http_post_token` is returned only in this response; save it. Fire the trigger with `POST` to `http_post_trigger_url` and the header `Authorization: Bearer <http_post_token>`; the optional JSON body `{"text": "..."}` is limited to 256 KB.
- If any `oncall_incident_*` field is sent, both `oncall_incident_channel_ids` and `oncall_incident_severities` must be non-empty. Matching incidents start runs with `trigger_kind=oncall_incident`.
- If `war_room_trigger_enabled=true` or `war_room_channel_ids` is sent, both `war_room_channel_ids` and `war_room_severities` must be non-empty. When a war room (IM group chat) is created for a matching incident, the agent runs inside that group chat and the run has `trigger_kind=war_room_created`.
- Runs started through the API execute in the web console (`execution_place=web_console`); `run_in=current-chat` is accepted only from a live IM conversation with the AI SRE agent and is rejected here.
- The response is the created rule; `can_edit` is always `true` for the creator.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **300 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **MCP Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- `command`/`args`/`env` apply to `stdio`; `url`/`headers` apply to `sse`/`streamable-http`.
- `server_name` must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, `-`, or `_`, and must be unique within its scope (account-wide or one team); violations return `InvalidParameter`.
- Without `source_template_name`, creating into a team (`team_id > 0`) requires the caller to belong to that team, and only the account owner or an admin may create at account scope (`team_id=0`).
- Setting `source_template_name` installs a marketplace template: the template must exist (`ResourceNotFound` otherwise), `team_id` is ignored and the server is created at account scope, and the connection fields must equal the template's own except for its declared parameter values. Templates with per-user auth whose parameters let the installer choose the destination host can be installed only by the account owner or an admin.
- Each `environments` entry must be `cloud` or the ID of a BYOC runner that is account-scoped or belongs to one of the caller's teams; duplicates are dropped and an empty string is rejected. Omitted or empty means all environments.
- `per_user_secret` auth mode requires `secret_schema` to be valid JSON with a non-empty `header_name`.
- `env` and `headers` values are masked when the key name contains `KEY`, `SECRET`, `TOKEN`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWD`, `CREDENTIAL`, or `AUTHORIZATION` (case-insensitive), or has a `PWD` / `PASS` segment, or the value is encrypted at rest; such values are also encrypted at rest.
- The response is the stored server. Its tool list is then fetched in the background through an already-online execution environment; the call does not wait for it.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/day**; **200 requests/minute**; **20 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- A personal session can be exported only by its creator; a team session by any member of the same account. Share links do not grant export. Missing or deleted sessions return `ResourceNotFound`.
- The response is `application/x-ndjson` — parse it line by line and write it to a file instead of buffering the whole body.
- The first line is always a `session_meta` object. Following lines carry a `type` of `user_message`, `system_reminder`, `agent_text`, `tool_call`, `subagent_dispatch`, `llm_call`, `final_answer`, or `session_fork`.

A2AAgentCreateRequest.description: Registration parameters for a new A2A agent.

agent_name.description: Agent display name, used to address the agent in sessions. Must not contain `@`, must not be `general` or `explore`, and must be unique within its scope (account-wide or one team).

instructions.description: Natural-language instructions for the remote agent: a Markdown document with optional `summary` frontmatter and a non-empty body, at most 50 KiB (51200 bytes). Required — a deprecated `description` field is still accepted for legacy clients and, if both are sent, must exactly match `instructions`.

card_url.description: URL of the remote agent card. Must be an absolute `http` or `https` URL with a non-empty host; a URL with no path is resolved to `/.well-known/agent-card.json`. If an execution environment is online, the card is fetched and must declare an A2A 1.x `JSONRPC` or `HTTP+JSON` interface.

auth_type.description:
Authentication used to reach the remote agent with a shared credential:
- `none`: no credential header.
- `api_key`: sends `auth_config.api_key` in the header named by `auth_config.header`.
- `bearer`: sends `Authorization: Bearer <auth_config.token>`.

When omitted the value is stored as an empty string, which behaves like `none`.

auth_config.description: Shared credential key-values: `header` and `api_key` for `auth_type=api_key`, `token` for `auth_type=bearer`. Values of `api_key`, `token`, and `client_secret` are encrypted at rest and masked in responses.

streaming.description: Whether the remote agent supports streaming.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Creating at account scope requires the owner/admin role; creating into a team requires actual membership in that team.

environments.description: Execution environments this agent is callable from: `cloud` and/or BYOC runner environment IDs. Omitted or empty means all environments.

auth_mode.description:
Who supplies the credential:
- `shared` (default; an empty value behaves the same): one credential stored on the agent (`auth_type` + `auth_config`) is used for every caller.
- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

`per_user_secret` requires `secret_schema` with a non-empty `header_name`; any other value returns `InvalidParameter`.

secret_schema.description: JSON-encoded secret schema, e.g. `{"header_name":"X-Api-Key"}`; required when `auth_mode=per_user_secret`.

oauth_metadata.description: JSON-encoded OAuth metadata; populated by the OAuth discovery flow for `per_user_oauth` mode.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow non-loopback HTTP OAuth discovery/metadata endpoints for this agent instead of requiring HTTPS. Defaults to false.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this agent's endpoint (self-signed/private certs). Defaults to false.

card_url.description: URL of the remote agent card.

- `bearer`: sends `Authorization: Bearer <auth_config.token>`.

An empty string means `auth_type` was omitted at creation and behaves like `none`.

Values of `api_key`, `token`, `client_secret`, and any other value stored encrypted are masked: longer than 8 characters shows the first and last 4 characters around `****`, otherwise `****`. Omitted when empty.

streaming.description: Whether the remote agent supports streaming responses.

status.description:

- `disabled`: kept but not offered; re-enable with `POST /safari/a2a-agent/enable`.

agent_card_name.description: Agent name read from the remote card on older records. The server no longer fills this in, so it is omitted for new agents.

agent_card_skills.description: Skill names read from the remote card on older records. The server no longer fills this in, so it is omitted for new agents.

card_resolve_timeout.description: Card-resolution timeout in seconds. Always 0 today — the API does not yet expose a way to set it.

task_timeout.description: Single-task execution timeout in seconds. Always 0 today — the API does not yet expose a way to set it.

- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this agent's endpoint.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the agent.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

A2AAgentListRequest.description: Pagination, scope, and search filter for listing A2A agents.

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of rows to skip, starting from 0.

limit.description: Page size; 0 or less falls back to 20. No upper bound is enforced.

scope.description: Visibility scope: `all` (account-scope plus the caller's visible teams), `account` (account-scope only), or `team` (team-scoped rows across the caller's visible teams).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring search across agent name, instructions, card URL, agent ID, and the resolved card name.

team_ids.description: Restrict to these team IDs. IDs of teams the caller does not belong to are ignored; empty means all of the caller's teams.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (`team_id=0`) rows. Defaults to `true`; ignored when `scope` is `account` (always included) or `team` (never included).

A2AAgentUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of an A2A agent. A null/omitted field is left unchanged.

agent_id.description: Target agent ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/a2a-agent/list`.

agent_name.description: New display name; omit to leave unchanged. Same rules as create: no `@`, not `general` / `explore`, unique within the scope.

instructions.description: New instructions document (same contract as create: optional `summary` frontmatter, non-empty body, at most 50 KiB). Omit to leave unchanged. A deprecated `description` field is also accepted; if both are sent they must match.

card_url.description: New card URL; omit to leave unchanged. Validated and compatibility-checked the same way as on create; a real change also clears `oauth_metadata` unless a new one is sent.

auth_type.description:
New auth type; omit to leave unchanged.
- `none`: no credential header.
- `api_key`: sends `auth_config.api_key` in the header named by `auth_config.header`.
- `bearer`: sends `Authorization: Bearer <auth_config.token>`.

auth_config.description: Replace the whole auth config; omit to leave unchanged. Keys missing from the map are dropped. For a sensitive key, sending back the masked value keeps the stored secret, while sending an empty string clears it.

streaming.description: Toggle streaming support. Omit to leave unchanged.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope; omit to leave unchanged. Moving to a team requires membership in it; moving to account scope (`0`) requires the account owner or an admin. If the team changes without `environments` in the same request, the current runner entries must stay selectable by the caller or the update is rejected.

environments.description: Execution environments this agent is callable from: `cloud` and/or BYOC runner environment IDs. Omit (null) to leave unchanged; send a list to set it — an empty list clears the restriction back to all environments.

auth_mode.description:
New auth mode; omit to leave unchanged. Values (who supplies the credential):
- `shared` (default; an empty value behaves the same): one credential stored on the agent (`auth_type` + `auth_config`) is used for every caller.
- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

When sent, `secret_schema` is overwritten with the value in the same request.

secret_schema.description: New JSON secret schema, e.g. `{"header_name":"X-Api-Key"}`. Applied only together with `auth_mode`; sent alone it is ignored.

oauth_metadata.description: New JSON OAuth metadata. A non-empty value is stored as sent. When omitted or empty, the stored value is kept unless `auth_mode` or `card_url` changes, in which case it is cleared.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Toggle non-loopback HTTP OAuth discovery for this agent. Omit to leave unchanged.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Toggle TLS certificate verification skipping for this agent. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: Display name of the rule, 1–255 characters; leading and trailing spaces are trimmed.

team_id.description: Scope of the rule. `0` or omitted: a personal rule owned by the caller. `>0`: a team rule; the caller must be a member of that team. The scope cannot be changed after creation.

run_in.description: Where the rule's runs execute. `web` (default): in a web console session. `current-chat`: in the IM chat the rule is created from; accepted only from a live IM conversation with the AI SRE agent, so API calls that send it get `400`.

enabled.description: Whether the rule's automatic triggers (schedule, HTTP POST, On-call incident, war room) are armed after creation. Defaults to `false`. Manual runs work either way.

cron_expr.description: Schedule in local time of `timezone`. Accepts 4 fields (`hour day month weekday`, minute defaults to 0) or 5 fields (`minute hour day month weekday`). The minute must be one fixed integer; seconds (6 fields) are not supported; setting both day-of-month and day-of-week is rejected. Required even for rules that use only other triggers: send a valid expression with `schedule_trigger_enabled=false`.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name used to evaluate `cron_expr`, e.g. `Asia/Shanghai`. Ambiguous names such as `Local`, `CST`, `UTC+8`, and `GMT+8` are rejected. When omitted: the caller's member time zone, then the account time zone, then `Asia/Shanghai`.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled. Defaults to `true` when omitted; send `false` for rules that should fire only from other triggers.

prompt.description: Task instruction sent to the AI SRE agent on every run. Must not be empty after trimming spaces.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind. Omit or send an empty value for automatic selection. One of: `cloud` (platform-hosted cloud sandbox), `byoc` (a self-hosted BYOC runner in the account, used with `environment_id`); automatic selection prefers an online BYOC runner and falls back to the cloud sandbox.

environment_id.description: BYOC runner ID. Required when `environment_kind=byoc` and rejected for other kinds. A personal rule can only use account-scope runners; a team rule can use account-scope runners or runners of its own team.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether to create an enabled HTTP POST trigger. When `true`, the response carries `http_post_trigger_url` and the one-time `http_post_token`.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the On-call incident trigger is enabled. When the trigger is created (this is `true`, or channel IDs or severities are sent), both `oncall_incident_channel_ids` and `oncall_incident_severities` must be non-empty.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: Channel IDs to watch; incidents in these channels can start a run. Each ID must be positive.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Incident severities to watch: `Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels.

oncall_incident_merge_similar.description: Whether to merge similar incidents into one analysis. When `true` (default), an incident that closely resembles one already being analyzed by this rule (a run in progress or finished within the last 10 minutes) joins that run's session instead of starting a new one; its own run is recorded as `skipped` with `joined_session_id` set. When `false`, every matching incident starts its own run.

war_room_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the war room trigger is enabled. It fires when a war room (IM group chat) is created for an incident in one of `war_room_channel_ids` with a severity in `war_room_severities`; the agent then runs inside that group chat. When the trigger is created (this is `true`, or `war_room_channel_ids` is sent), both lists must be non-empty.

war_room_channel_ids.description: Channel IDs whose war rooms start a run. Each ID must be positive.

war_room_severities.description: Incident severities that start a run when their war room is created: `Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels.

rule_id.description: Rule ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/automation/rule/list`.
Rule ID (prefix `arule_`). Pass it as `rule_id` to get, update, delete, run, and list-runs calls.

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns the rule.

team_id.description: Scope team ID; `0` means a personal rule. Fixed at creation.

owner_id.description: Person ID of the member who created the rule. For a personal rule, the only person who can manage it.

enabled.description: Whether the rule's automatic triggers are armed. A disabled rule can still be run manually. A personal rule is disabled automatically when its owner leaves the account.

run_scope.description: Hidden session run scope. One of: `person` (personal rule, team_id=0, runs as the creator; disabled when the creator leaves the account), `team` (team rule, team_id>0, owned by the team and shared with its members; survives the creator leaving). Derived from the rule's team_id.

cron_expr.description: Normalized 5-field cron expression (`minute hour day month weekday`), evaluated in `timezone`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone `cron_expr` is evaluated in. Always populated for rules created after this field shipped; empty on legacy rows created before it, which still resolve to UTC when scheduled.

prompt.description: Task instruction sent to the AI SRE agent on every run.

environment_kind.description: Runtime environment kind. Omit or send an empty value for automatic selection. One of: `cloud` (platform-hosted cloud sandbox), `byoc` (self-hosted BYOC runner in the account); an empty value means automatic selection (prefers an online BYOC runner, falls back to the cloud sandbox).

environment_id.description: BYOC runner ID when `environment_kind=byoc`; empty string otherwise.

schedule_trigger_id.description: Schedule trigger ID. Omitted if the rule has no schedule trigger.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled.

http_post_trigger_id.description: HTTP POST trigger ID. Omitted when the rule has no HTTP POST trigger.

http_post_trigger_url.description: Path to fire the HTTP POST trigger, `/safari/automation/triggers/{trigger_id}/fire`, relative to the API base URL. Send `POST` with `Authorization: Bearer <http_post_token>`. Omitted when the rule has no HTTP POST trigger.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the HTTP POST trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_trigger_id.description: On-call incident trigger ID. Omitted when the rule has no On-call incident trigger.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the On-call incident trigger is enabled.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: Channel IDs the On-call incident trigger watches. Omitted when the rule has no such trigger.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Incident severities the On-call incident trigger watches: `Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels. Omitted when the rule has no such trigger.

oncall_incident_merge_similar.description: Whether similar incidents are merged into one analysis (see the create request). `true` when the rule has no On-call incident trigger.

war_room_trigger_id.description: War room trigger ID. Omitted when the rule has no war room trigger.

war_room_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the war room trigger is enabled.

war_room_channel_ids.description: Channel IDs whose war rooms start a run. Omitted when the rule has no war room trigger.

war_room_severities.description: Incident severities whose war rooms start a run: `Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels. Omitted when the rule has no war room trigger.

execution_place.description: Where runs started by the schedule, HTTP POST, On-call incident, and manual triggers execute: `web_console` (a web console session) or `im` (the IM chat the rule was created from). War room runs always execute in the war room's group chat. Fixed at creation.

execution_location.description: Read-only description of where the rule runs.

place.description: Same as the rule's `execution_place`: `web_console` runs in a web console session, `im` runs in the bound IM chat.

run_scope.description: `person`: runs as the owner; `team`: runs under the team in `team_id`.

team_id.description: Team the runs belong to; `0` for a personal rule.

platform.description: IM platform of the bound chat: `feishu` (Feishu/Lark), `dingtalk` (DingTalk), `wecom` (WeCom), `slack` (Slack), `teams` (Microsoft Teams). Present only when `place=im`.

conversation_mode.description: Conversation type of the bound chat: `direct` (one-to-one chat with the bot), `group_chat` (a group chat), `group_thread` (a thread in a group chat), `war_room_chat` (an incident war room). Present only when `place=im`.

chat_name.description: Name of the bound chat. Present only when `place=im` and the name is known.

description.description: Human-readable destination label: `Web console` for web console rules, otherwise the chat name or platform and conversation type.

last_run.description: The rule's most recent run. Returned only by List Automation rules, and only when the rule has run at least once.

run_id.description: Run ID, as in List Automation runs.

status.description: Run status, same meanings as `status` in List Automation runs: `queued`, `running`, `retrying` (in progress); `succeeded`, `partial`, `failed`, `skipped` (did not execute or merged into another run), `abandoned` (never completed), `blocked` (ended waiting on a connector authorization).

http_post_token.description: HTTP POST trigger token. Returned only in the response that issues it: create with `http_post_trigger_enabled=true`, an update that creates the trigger, or an update with `rotate_http_post_trigger_token=true`. Save it; it cannot be read again.

can_edit.description: `true` when the caller can manage (get, update, delete, run) this rule: the owner of a personal rule, or a member of a team rule's team. Account owners and admins get no exemption.

schedule_next_fire_at_ms.description: Next scheduled fire time, Unix milliseconds. 0 means no future scheduled fire is available.

AutomationRuleListRequest.description: List Automation rules visible to the caller: their own personal rules plus rules of teams they belong to. Account owners and admins are bounded the same way.

limit.description: Page size. Values below 1 fall back to 20; values above 200 are capped at 200.

scope.description: Scope filter: `all` (default) your personal rules plus rules of your teams; `personal` only your personal rules; `team` only rules of your teams.

team_ids.description: Filter to these team IDs; this narrows results and does not expand access.

include_person.description: Legacy switch. Only read when `scope` is empty: `false` behaves like `scope=team`; otherwise ignored.

enabled.description: Filter by enabled state: `true` returns only enabled rules, `false` only disabled; omit or pass null for no filter.

keyword.description: Returns rules whose name contains this text. At most 64 characters.

total.description: Number of rules matching the filters across all pages.

rules.description: Array of automation rules for the current page, used with `total` for pagination.

AutomationRuleUpdateRequest.description: Update an Automation rule. Omit or send null on a field to leave it unchanged.

rule_id.description: Target rule ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/automation/rule/list`.

name.description: New display name, at most 255 characters. An empty string after trimming is rejected.

team_id.description: The rule's scope cannot be changed. Omit this field, or send the current value; any other value returns `400`.

enabled.description: Whether the rule's automatic triggers are armed. Omit to keep the current value.

cron_expr.description: New schedule, same format as on create: 4 fields (`hour day month weekday`) or 5 fields (`minute hour day month weekday`), fixed-integer minute, no seconds, not both day-of-month and day-of-week. Omit to keep the current expression.

timezone.description: New IANA time zone for `cron_expr`. An empty string stores `UTC`. Omit or send `null` to keep the current time zone.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled. Omit to keep the current value.

prompt.description: New task instruction for the agent. Omit to keep the current one.

environment_kind.description: New runtime environment: `""` automatic selection (prefers an online BYOC runner, falls back to the cloud sandbox), `cloud` platform-hosted cloud sandbox, `byoc` the runner in `environment_id`. Sending this without `environment_id` clears the stored `environment_id`.

environment_id.description: BYOC runner ID; required when the resulting `environment_kind` is `byoc`, rejected otherwise.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Enable or disable the HTTP POST trigger. `true` on a rule without one creates it and returns its token in this response.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Enable or disable the On-call incident trigger. Creating it on a rule that has none also needs `oncall_incident_channel_ids` and `oncall_incident_severities`.

oncall_incident_channel_ids.description: Replaces the watched channel IDs when non-empty; an empty or omitted list keeps the stored IDs.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Replaces the watched severities when non-empty (`Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels); an empty or omitted list keeps the stored values.

oncall_incident_merge_similar.description: Whether to merge similar incidents into one analysis (see the create request). Omit to keep the current value.

war_room_trigger_enabled.description: Enable or disable the war room trigger. Creating it on a rule that has none also needs `war_room_channel_ids` and `war_room_severities`. Omit to keep the current value.

war_room_channel_ids.description: Replaces the channel IDs whose war rooms start a run when non-empty; an empty or omitted list keeps the stored IDs.

war_room_severities.description: Replaces the war room severities when non-empty (`Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels); an empty or omitted list keeps the stored values.

rotate_http_post_trigger_token.description: When `true`, issues a new HTTP POST trigger token and invalidates the old one. The trigger must exist and be enabled. The new token is returned only in this response.

session_id.description: AI SRE session the run executed in. Omitted when the run has not started a session, when it joined another run (see `joined_session_id`), or when it executed in an IM chat.

session_name.description: Display name of the run's session, stamped via a batch lookup. Omitted when empty or when the lookup fails.

joined_session_id.description: For an On-call incident run merged into a similar incident's analysis (`status=skipped`): the session it joined. Omitted otherwise.

joined_session_name.description: Display name of `joined_session_id`. Omitted when empty or when the name lookup fails.

kind.description: Run kind; runs listed for a rule are always `automation_rule`.

account_id.description: ID of the account that owns the run.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule this run belongs to.

trigger_kind.description:
Trigger kind. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `schedule` | Fired by the rule's schedule trigger |
| `debug` | Debug run (reserved; current rule runs never carry this kind) |
| `manual` | Started with Run Automation rule |
| `http_post` | Fired via the rule's HTTP POST trigger |
| `oncall_incident` | Fired by a matching On-call incident |
| `war_room_created` | Fired when a war room was created for a matching incident; runs in that group chat |

execution_place.description: Where this run executed: `web_console` (a web console session; `session_id` links to it) or `im` (an IM chat; session details are withheld). `war_room_created` runs are always `im`.

occurrence_key.description: Idempotency key of this occurrence: `manual:<run_id>` for manual runs, `<trigger_id>:<scheduled fire time in Unix ms>` for schedule runs, `oncall_incident:<trigger_id>:<incident_id>` for On-call incident runs.

status.description:
Run status. One of (the first three are in-flight, the rest terminal):
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `queued` | Enqueued, waiting for a worker |
| `running` | Executing |
| `retrying` | An attempt failed and a retry is scheduled |
| `succeeded` | Completed successfully |
| `partial` | Partially succeeded (currently only produced by memory-consolidation runs; rule runs never reach it) |
| `failed` | Terminal failure, no further retries |
| `skipped` | Not executed (e.g. grace period expired, trigger or rule invalid); the reason is kept on the run record. Also used for an On-call incident run merged into a similar incident's analysis (see `joined_session_id`) |
| `abandoned` | Still in-flight past the stale threshold and swept as never-completed (e.g. worker died) |
| `blocked` | Terminal: the run produced output but ended with a connector waiting on a human to complete authorization (distinct from `failed`) |

attempts.description: Number of execution attempts made for this run.

completed_at.description: Completion time, Unix milliseconds. 0 means not completed.

error_code.description: Error code; empty when the run did not fail.

error_message.description: Error message; empty when the run did not fail.

stats_json.description: Raw run statistics JSON; null when empty.

result_json.description: Raw run result JSON (carries `session_id` once a session started). `null` when empty or when the run executed in an IM chat.

rule_id.description: Target rule ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/automation/rule/list`.

limit.description: Page size. Values below 1 fall back to 20.

status.description: Run status filter: `queued`, `running`, `retrying`, `succeeded`, `partial` (partially succeeded), `failed`, `skipped` (e.g. rule or trigger no longer valid), `abandoned` (stale run terminated by the system), `blocked` (terminal; produced output but a connector is waiting on a human authorization); omit for no filter.

trigger_kind.description: Trigger filter: `schedule` schedule trigger, `debug` debug run, `manual` manual run, `http_post` HTTP POST trigger, `oncall_incident` On-call incident trigger, `war_room_created` war room trigger; omit for no filter.

started_after_ms.description: Start-time lower bound, Unix milliseconds. Values below the 180-day run-history retention floor are clamped to it (that floor is also the default when omitted).

started_before_ms.description: Start-time upper bound, Unix milliseconds. Must be greater than or equal to the effective `started_after_ms`; a value below the retention floor yields an empty result.

total.description: Number of runs matching the filters across all pages.

runs.description: Array of run records for the given `rule_id`, filtered by the request's status/trigger-kind/time-range and paginated.

AutomationRunView.description: Reference to the run started by a manual trigger.

run_id.description: Run ID, always populated once a run is created.

session_id.description: AI SRE session started for this run. Omitted when the rule executes in an IM chat (`execution_place=im`).

name.description: Localized template name; use it as the rule `name`.

key.description: Stable, locale-independent template ID (lowercase letters, digits, underscores). Present only on templates that other console pages link to directly; omitted otherwise.

description.description: Localized explanation of what a rule created from this template does.

icon.description: Icon identifier the console displays for the template, e.g. `siren`.

category.description: Free-text, localized name of the group the template is shown under in the console, e.g. `Incident Response`. Groups appear in the order of their first template.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Prefill for `schedule_trigger_enabled`; `true` exactly when `cron_expr` is present.

cron_expr.description: Prefill for `cron_expr`. Omitted when the template does not use the schedule trigger; the create request still needs a valid `cron_expr`.

oncall_incident_trigger_enabled.description: Prefill for `oncall_incident_trigger_enabled`; when `true`, add `oncall_incident_channel_ids` before creating.

oncall_incident_severities.description: Prefill for `oncall_incident_severities` (`Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels). Omitted when the template does not use the On-call incident trigger.

war_room_trigger_enabled.description: Prefill for `war_room_trigger_enabled`; when `true`, add `war_room_channel_ids` before creating.

war_room_severities.description: Prefill for `war_room_severities` (`Critical` (most severe), `Warning`, or `Info` (least severe) — the On-call incident severity levels). Omitted when the template does not use the war room trigger.

locale.description: Template language. A value containing `zh` returns Chinese, one containing `en` returns English, any other non-empty value returns Chinese. When omitted, the `locale`/`lang` query parameter or the `Accept-Language` header decides, defaulting to Chinese.

templates.description: Built-in templates in the resolved language, in display order.

ContextResolvedItem.description: Knowledge versions the session's context resolved. In `POST /safari/session/get` only `versions` is filled (with `resolved_at_ms` = 0); the object is omitted until the agent has resolved knowledge at least once.

incident_id.description: Bound incident id, when war-room originated.

resolved_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the knowledge was resolved.

versions.description: Map from knowledge ID to the version the agent last loaded.

DutyError.description: Error payload inside the response envelope. Present only on non-2xx responses.

message.description: Human-readable error message in the response language (`locale` / `lang` query parameter or `Accept-Language` header). May name the offending field; do not parse it.
message.example: The specified parameter template_id is not valid.

EnvironmentBinding.description: The runner or cloud sandbox the session is bound to. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only; omitted until the session has been bound (after its first message).

kind.description: Environment kind bound to the session: `cloud` (managed sandbox) or `byoc` (self-hosted runner).

id.description: Environment identifier: a cloud sandbox ID for `cloud` bindings, a runner/environment ID for `byoc` bindings.

name.description: Human-readable environment name; empty for cloud bindings using the default allowlist.

team_id.description: Team that owns the bound environment; 0 for account-scope environments.

status.description:
Live health of the binding. Omitted when unknown.

For `byoc`:
- `online`: runner connected and ready
- `degraded`: runner connected but its executor is unhealthy; messages are still accepted
- `pending`: runner has never connected
- `offline`: runner heartbeat lost; messages cannot be served
- `deleted`: the environment no longer exists; choose another

For `cloud`:
- `available`: the sandbox can serve the next message (paused or starting sandboxes resume automatically)
- `rebuilding`: the sandbox is being resumed or recreated
- `expired`: the sandbox failed permanently and cannot recover by itself
- `deleted`: the selected cloud environment template was deleted

ErrorCode.description:
Error code. Every failed response sets `error.code` to one of these stable strings; branch on it rather than on the HTTP status.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `OK` | 200 | Reserved; never returned on a failed request. |
| `InvalidParameter` | 400 | A parameter is missing, has the wrong type, or failed validation; `message` usually names the field. |
| `BadRequest` | 400 | The request breaks a business rule or conflicts with the current state of an object; `message` says which. |
| `InvalidContentType` | 400 | The body is not sent as `application/json`. |
| `ResourceNotFound` | 400 | The referenced object does not exist in this account or was deleted. Returned as HTTP 400, not 404. |
| `NoLicense` | 400 | The account's plan does not include the feature, a plan quota is used up, the plan has expired, or credits are insufficient. |
| `ReferenceExist` | 400 | The object is still referenced by other objects, so it cannot be deleted. |
| `Unauthorized` | 401 | The APP Key is missing, invalid, or deleted. |
| `BalanceNotEnough` | 402 | Console-only (billing); not returned by Open API operations. |
| `AccessDenied` | 403 | The APP Key's permission scope or the creator's role does not allow this operation or object. |
| `RouteNotFound` | 404 | No operation matches the HTTP method and path. |
| `MethodNotAllowed` | 405 | The path exists but not for this HTTP method. |
| `UndonedOrderExist` | 409 | Console-only (billing); not returned by Open API operations. |
| `EntityTooLarge` | 413 | The request body exceeds the size limit. |
| `RequestLocked` | 423 | Console-only (sign-in protection); not returned by Open API operations. |
| `RequestVerifyRequired` | 428 | Console-only (verification code); not returned by Open API operations. |
| `DangerousOperation` | 428 | Console-only (MFA for high-risk actions); not returned by Open API operations. |
| `RequestTooFrequently` | 429 | A rate limit was hit; wait for the `Flashcat-Request-Rate-Limit-Delay` response header (seconds) before retrying. |
| `InternalError` | 500 | Unexpected server error; retry with backoff and include `request_id` when reporting. |
| `ServiceUnavailable` | 503 | A backend dependency is overloaded or unavailable; retry with backoff. |
