ErrorResponse.description: Response envelope for errors. `error` is required; `data` is absent.

request_id.description: Unique trace ID of this request; include it when reporting issues so logs can be located.

EventItem.description: One persisted session event. content/actions/usage_metadata carry the raw ADK envelope; treat them as opaque structured payloads.

invocation_id.description: ID of the invocation (one agent turn) that wrote this event. Omitted when empty.

root_invocation_id.description: Invocation ID of the top-level user turn this event belongs to, linking events written by nested subagent invocations back to it. Omitted when empty.

delivery_mode.description: Delivery mode negotiated for the IM request that produced this event. `reply_only`: the IM client shows only explicit replies, not the agent's final text. Omitted for normal delivery.

is_error.description: True when this is an assistant event recording a runtime failure whose message is safe to show to users. Omitted when false.

author.description: Event author (e.g. user, the agent name).

person_id.description: Member ID of the person who sent this user message. Omitted on assistant and tool events and when no member is recorded (automation runs, some IM turns).

branch.description: ADK branch path for nested agents.

actions.description: ADK actions envelope (state deltas, transfers, escalation).

partial.description: True for a streaming partial chunk.

turn_complete.description: True on the terminal event of a turn.

error_code.description: Error code when the event represents a failure.

status.description: Event status. One of: `normal` (a live event included in the context fed to the model), `compressed` (folded into a compaction summary boundary event; no longer loaded for the model, kept as history only).

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the event was written.

MCPServerCreateRequest.description: Configuration for a new MCP server.

server_name.description: MCP server name: must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, `-`, or `_` (`@` is reserved); unique within its scope (account-wide or one team).

transport.description: Transport protocol: `stdio` launches a local process via `command`/`args`/`env`, `sse` / `streamable-http` connects to a remote service via `url`/`headers`.

env.description: Environment variables (`stdio` transport). Values under credential-looking names (containing `KEY`, `SECRET`, `TOKEN`, `PASSWORD`, …) are encrypted at rest and masked in responses.

headers.description: HTTP headers (`sse` / `streamable-http` transport). Values under credential-looking names (containing `KEY`, `TOKEN`, `AUTHORIZATION`, …) are encrypted at rest and masked in responses.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds. Omitted or `0` is stored as `0` and means the 10-second default.

call_timeout.description: Tool-call timeout in seconds. Omitted or `0` is stored as `0` and means the 60-second default.

auth_mode.description:
Who supplies the credential:
- `shared` (default; an empty value behaves the same): one credential stored on the server (`env` / `headers`) is used for every caller.
- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

`per_user_secret` requires `secret_schema` with a non-empty `header_name`; any other value returns `InvalidParameter`.

secret_schema.description: JSON secret schema; required when auth_mode=per_user_secret.

oauth_metadata.description: JSON OAuth metadata; reserved for per_user_oauth.

status.description: Initial status: `enabled` (default) or `disabled` (created but kept off).

team_id.description: Team scope: `0` = account-wide (account owner or admin only); `>0` = a team the caller belongs to. Ignored when `source_template_name` is set — marketplace installs are always account-wide.

environments.description: Execution environments this server is callable from: `cloud` and/or BYOC runner environment IDs. Omitted or empty means all environments.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow this server's OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP. Testing use only; defaults to false.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this server. Testing use only; defaults to false.

source_template_name.description: Name of the marketplace template to install. When set, the template must exist, the server is created at account scope, and the connection fields must match the template except for its declared parameter values. Cannot be changed later.

server_id.description: Target MCP server ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/mcp/server/list`.
Target MCP server ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/mcp/server/list`.

MCPServerItem.description: An MCP server (connector) registered on the account.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may update, enable, disable, or delete this server: `true` for an account-scoped server only for the account owner or an admin, for a team server only for members of that team. Create and update responses always return `true`.

environments.description: Execution environments this server is callable from (`cloud` and/or BYOC runner environment IDs). Always present; `[]` means all environments (also the value on legacy rows created before this field).

server_name.description: MCP server name, unique within its scope (account-wide or one team).

ai_description.description: LLM-generated description, preferred over `description` when present. Omitted when not yet generated.

transport.description: Transport protocol. One of: `stdio` (standard I/O to a local subprocess), `sse` (standalone SSE, the legacy MCP transport), `streamable-http` (the newer HTTP streaming transport).

env.description: Environment variables (`stdio` transport). Values under credential-looking names, or encrypted at rest, are masked: longer than 8 characters shows the first and last 4 characters around `****`, otherwise `****`. Omitted when empty.

headers.description: HTTP headers (`sse` / `streamable-http` transport), masked by the same rule as `env`. Omitted when empty.

proxy_url.description: Outbound proxy URL used to reach the server. Not settable through the public API; omitted when empty.

status.description:
Whether the server's tools are offered to AI SRE sessions:
- `enabled`: available (default on create).
- `disabled`: kept but not offered; re-enable with `POST /safari/mcp/server/enable`.

connect_timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds as stored; `0` means the 10-second default is used.

call_timeout.description: Tool-call timeout in seconds as stored; `0` means the 60-second default is used.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow this server's OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP; testing use only. Omitted when false.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to this server; testing use only. Omitted when false.

auth_mode.description:
Who supplies the credential; omitted when empty, which behaves like `shared`:
- `shared`: one credential stored on the server (`env` / `headers`) is used for every caller.
- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this server was installed from; omitted for servers created by hand.

test_error.description: Error message from the last connection test; omitted when the last test succeeded or the server was never tested.

tested_at.description: Time of the last connection test, Unix timestamp in milliseconds; omitted if the server was never tested.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the server.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

MCPServerListRequest.description: Pagination, scope, and search filters for listing MCP servers.

p.description: Page number, 1-based; values below 1 are treated as 1.

limit.description: Page size; values below 1 fall back to 20. No upper bound is enforced.

scope.description: Restrict results to a scope: `account` for account-wide rows only, `team` for the caller's own visible team rows only, or omit (defaults to `all`) for both, subject to team_ids/include_account.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring search across name, description, AI-generated description, server ID, transport, URL, command, and source template name.

team_ids.description: Restrict to these team IDs. IDs of teams the caller does not belong to are ignored; empty means all of the caller's teams.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (`team_id=0`) rows. Defaults to `true`; ignored when `scope` is `account` (always included) or `team` (never included).

server_id.description: Target MCP server ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/mcp/server/list`.

MCPServerUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of an MCP server. Omit a field to leave it unchanged.

server_id.description: Target MCP server ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/mcp/server/list`.

server_name.description: New name; omitted or empty leaves it unchanged.

description.description: New description; omitted or empty leaves it unchanged.

transport.description: Transport protocol; when switching, also supply the matching fields (`command`/`args`/`env` for `stdio`, `url`/`headers` for `sse` / `streamable-http`); omitted or empty leaves it unchanged.

command.description: New executable command (`stdio` transport); omitted or empty leaves it unchanged.

args.description: Command arguments (`stdio` transport); replaces the whole list — pass `[]` to clear, omit to leave unchanged.

env.description: Environment variables (`stdio` transport); replaces the whole map, so keys left out are removed. For a protected key (see the masking rule on get), sending the masked value or an empty string keeps the stored value. Omit to leave unchanged.

url.description: New server URL (`sse` / `streamable-http` transport); omitted or empty leaves it unchanged. A real change also clears `oauth_metadata` unless a new one is sent.

headers.description: HTTP headers (`sse` / `streamable-http` transport); replaces the whole map, with the same masked/empty-value preservation as `env`; omit to leave unchanged.

connect_timeout.description: New connection timeout in seconds; omitted or `0` leaves it unchanged (a stored `0` means the 10-second default).

call_timeout.description: New tool-call timeout in seconds; omitted or `0` leaves it unchanged (a stored `0` means the 60-second default).

auth_mode.description:
New auth mode; omitted or empty leaves it unchanged. Who supplies the credential:
- `shared` (default; an empty value behaves the same): one credential stored on the server (`env` / `headers`) is used for every caller.
- `per_user_secret`: each user stores their own secret, sent in the header named by `secret_schema.header_name`.
- `per_user_oauth`: each user completes their own OAuth authorization; discovery and client registration run on first use.

`per_user_secret` requires `secret_schema` with a non-empty `header_name`; any other value returns `InvalidParameter`.

secret_schema.description: New JSON secret schema, e.g. `{"header_name":"X-Api-Key"}`. Applied only together with a non-empty `auth_mode`; sent alone it is ignored.

oauth_metadata.description: New JSON OAuth metadata. A non-empty value is stored as sent. When omitted or empty, the stored value is kept unless `auth_mode` or `url` changes, in which case it is cleared.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: `0` = account-wide (account owner or admin only); `>0` = a team the caller belongs to. Servers installed from the marketplace can only move to `0`. Omit to leave unchanged.

environments.description: Execution environments this server is callable from: `cloud` and/or BYOC runner environment IDs. Omit (null) to leave unchanged; send a list to set it — an empty list clears the restriction back to all environments.

allow_insecure_oauth_http.description: Allow OAuth token exchange over plaintext HTTP. Omit to leave unchanged.

allow_insecure_tls_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Omit to leave unchanged.

ManualRunRuleResult.description: Result of manually running an Automation rule outside its schedule.

PendingUserMessage.description: A queued user message that the agent has not consumed yet, as carried by `pending_messages`.

invocation_id.description: Invocation ID of the queued message.

client_msg_id.description: Client-supplied message ID, echoed back for de-duplication. Omitted when absent.

steering.description: True when the message was sent as a mid-turn steering instruction. Omitted when false.

parts.description: Request parts passed through verbatim (text, file, ref, or skill entries). Omitted when the original message carried none.

PreflightResult.description: Readiness checks computed before a manual run is allowed to start.

ok.description: Whether all readiness checks passed. Always `true` in a 200 response; a failed preflight returns an error instead.

checks.description: Names of the readiness checks performed, in order. Current fixed set: rule_loaded, actor_authorized, app_allowed, runtime_scope_resolved, rule_config_valid.

scope.description: Resolved run scope for this run; mirrors the rule's run_scope. One of: `person` (personal rule, runs as its creator), `team` (team rule, runs under the owning team).

team_id.description: Rule's scope team ID; 0 means a personal rule.

app_name.description: App the rule is scoped to. Currently always ai-sre; manual runs are only supported for that app.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings from preflight. Currently never populated, so the field is omitted.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Standard response envelope used by every Flashduty public API. On success `data` contains the endpoint-specific payload and `error` is absent. On failure `error` is present and `data` is absent. `request_id` is always present and is also mirrored in the `Flashcat-Request-Id` response header.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request. Mirrored in the Flashcat-Request-Id header. Include it when reporting issues.

data.description: Operation-specific payload, documented in each operation's 200 response. Operations without a payload return `{}` or omit `data` entirely.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

include_subagents.description: When true, each subagent_dispatch line is followed by the child session's full event stream, bracketed by its own session_meta. Defaults to false.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

session_id.description: Target session ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/session/list`.

share_token.description: Share token for accessing a session through its share link. Omit it for normal account-authorized access.

num_recent_events.description: Legacy page size: number of most-recent events to return. Superseded by `limit` when both are set; 0 uses the server default (100).

limit.description: Page size for events; takes precedence over `num_recent_events`. 0 uses the server default (100).

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response; pass it back to fetch the next older page.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

events.description: The newest page of events (older pages via `search_after_ctx`), ascending by (`created_at`, `event_id`). Internal control events are excluded. Always an array.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

pending_messages.description: Human messages queued but not yet picked up by the agent, in execution order. Always an array — empty when nothing is queued.

parent_session_id.description: Parent session id for subagent (child) sessions; empty otherwise.

session_name.description: Session title; may be empty for untitled sessions.

app_name.description: Agent app that owns the session.

entry_kind.description:
Surface that created the session:
- `web`: web console (also returned for subagent child sessions and for sessions that predate this field)
- `im`: IM bot or IM H5 client
- `api`: public API
- `automation`: automation rule (unattended run)

ref.description: Business object the session is about, as a prefixed reference (for example an incident reference). Omitted when the session is not bound to one.

creator_name.description: Display name of the session creator. Returned by `POST /safari/session/list` only; omitted when the name lookup fails.

team_id.description: Owning team id; 0 means no team is bound. Immutable after create.

team_name.description: Resolved team name; empty for unbound rows or deleted teams.

automation.description: Automation rule that produced this session. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only, for sessions started by an automation rule.

rule_name.description: Rule name; empty when the rule has since been deleted.

trigger_kind.description:
How this run was triggered:
- `schedule`: the rule's schedule fired
- `manual`: run on demand (console or `POST /safari/automation/rule/run`)
- `http_post`: the rule's HTTP trigger URL was called
- `oncall_incident`: an On-call incident event matched the rule
- `war_room_created`: a war room was created
- `""`: the run record no longer exists

can_edit.description: True when the caller may open and manage the rule; false when the rule has been deleted.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

can_view.description: True when the caller can read this session: always true for the creator, team members, and other members of the same account on a team session; true through a valid share link otherwise.

can_continue.description: True when the caller can add a new turn to this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename, archive, or delete the session: the creator of a personal session, or the creator or a member of the owning team for a team session. Account owners and admins get no exemption.

can_fork.description: True when the caller can fork this session.

access_source.description:
How the caller obtained access. Omitted when the caller has no access. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `owner` | Caller created the session (full access) |
| `team_member` | Caller belongs to the session's team (full access) |
| `manager` | Reserved; not produced by the current version |
| `share_link` | Granted by a valid share link (view and fork only; view only for subagent child sessions) |
| `participant` | Another member of the same account on a team session (view, continue, fork; no manage) |

share_enabled.description: True when the session's share link is active.

share_version.description: Revision of the share link; it increases when sharing is revoked.

shared_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when sharing was last enabled; 0 if never shared.

shared_by.description: Person ID that most recently enabled sharing; 0 if never shared.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Always `enabled` in responses: deleted sessions are never returned.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

state.description: Raw session-state key/value map. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only; omitted when empty.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

context_window.description: Maximum context size of the session's model, in tokens. Computed by `POST /safari/session/get` only; always 0 in list responses and when the lookup fails.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

pinned_at.description: When the caller pinned this session, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds; 0 when not pinned. Pins are per user. Filled by `POST /safari/session/list` only; always 0 in `POST /safari/session/get`.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the latest assistant-side event; user messages alone do not advance it. Omitted when 0.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

standing_tasks.description: Number of the session's process-type tasks (background shell commands or monitors) still alive when the response was built; 0 when none or when the count cannot be read.

has_unread.description: True when assistant output exists that the caller has not viewed yet; always false while `is_running` is true. Computed by `POST /safari/session/list` only; always false in `POST /safari/session/get`.

has_open_tasks.description: True when the session still has open tasks (for example running subagents or background processes), which tells a handed-off turn apart from a settled session. Returned by `POST /safari/session/get` only; omitted when false or when the lookup fails, so treat absence as unknown rather than idle.

current_turn_started_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the current or most recent round started; 0 if no round has started yet.

current_turn_active_ms.description: Active working duration in milliseconds for the current or most recent round, excluding time spent waiting on ask_user; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_wait_ms.description: Accumulated ask_user human-wait duration in milliseconds for the current round; resets to 0 at the start of each new round.

current_turn_tokens.description: Total tokens (input+output+reasoning) for the in-flight round across the parent and its subagents; only computed by session/get while the session is running, always 0 in session/list responses and when idle.

SessionListRequest.description: Filters for listing agent sessions. `all` visibility means the caller's own personal sessions plus accessible team sessions; account admins do not see other users' personal sessions.

app_name.description:
Agent app whose sessions to list. One of:
| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ask-ai` | Ask AI assistant |
| `support` | Customer-support agent |
| `support-website` | Website support agent (exposed over A2A, not built into the console) |
| `support-flashcat` | Flashcat-site support agent (exposed over A2A) |
| `ai-sre` | The AI SRE main app |
| `template-assistant` | Notification-template assistant (template editing/validation) |
| `query-assistant` | Monitors query-writing assistant |
| `swe` | Software-engineering agent app (not offered in the console) |

orderby.description: Sort field: `created_at` by creation time, `updated_at` by last update; defaults to `updated_at` when omitted.

asc.description: Ascending order when true, descending when false. Only honored together with `orderby`; when `orderby` is omitted the sort is always `updated_at` descending.

include_subagent_sessions.description: When true, also list child sessions spawned by subagent dispatch. Defaults to false (top-level sessions only).

keyword.description: Return only sessions whose `session_name` contains this text; leading and trailing spaces are ignored.

scope.description:
Visibility scope:
- `all` (default): sessions the caller created plus sessions bound to teams the caller belongs to
- `personal`: the caller's own sessions with no team (`team_id` = 0)
- `team`: sessions bound to teams the caller belongs to; empty when the caller is in no team

team_ids.description: Optional explicit team filter; intersects with `scope` and never expands access.

person_ids.description: Filter by who started the session: returns only sessions started by these members (a session is kept when `person_id` matches any of them). Intersects with `scope` and `team_ids`, so it never widens what the caller is allowed to see.

entry_kinds.description: Restrict to sessions created from these surfaces: `web` (console), `im` (IM bot or IM H5), `api` (public API), `automation` (automation rule). Empty returns every kind.

status.description:
Archive filter:
- `active` (default): sessions that are not archived
- `archived`: archived sessions only
- `all`: both

total.description: Number of matching sessions, ignoring pagination. Pinned sessions prepended on page 1 are not counted.

sessions.description: The page of sessions: on page 1, the caller's matching pinned sessions (newest pin first) followed by up to `limit` other sessions in the requested order.

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.
Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

SkillItem.description: An AI SRE skill — a packaged SKILL.md bundle the agent can load.

team_id.description: Team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = the owning team.

skill_name.description: Skill name, unique within its scope (account-wide or within one team).

description.description: Human-readable description from the SKILL.md frontmatter.

description_en.description: Optional English description. English-locale UI responses prefer this over `description`; the skill catalog also uses it as a stable selection signal when `description` is localized for display.

content.description: Full SKILL.md content. Omitted in list responses.

venues.description: Execution environments the skill is restricted to: `cloud` (managed sandbox) and/or `byoc` (self-hosted runner). Omitted when empty, which means every environment.

s3_key.description: Object-storage key of the skill zip.

checksum.description: SHA-256 checksum of the skill zip.

status.description: Skill status: `enabled` (agents load it) or `disabled` (kept but not loaded). Deleted skills never appear in responses.

created_by.description: Member ID that created the skill.

created_at.description: Creation time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time. Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

can_edit.description: True when the caller may change this skill: account owners and admins for account-scope skills, team members for team skills.

source_template_name.description: Marketplace template this skill was installed from; empty for user-authored.

update_available.description: True when the marketplace template this skill was installed from has a newer version. Computed by `POST /safari/skill/list` only; always false in other responses.

is_modified.description: True when a marketplace-installed skill was changed locally (for example by uploading a new archive); automatic marketplace updates skip it.

created.description: Not returned by these endpoints; it is set only by the install-from-session flow.

examples.description: Example prompts declared in the SKILL.md frontmatter (up to 10), shown as suggested questions. Omitted when none.

SkillListRequest.description: Pagination, search, and team filter for listing skills.

p.description: Page number, 1-based; values below 1 fall back to 1.

limit.description: Page size; values below 1 fall back to 20.

scope.description:
Which skills to return; overrides `include_account` when set:
- `all` (default): account-scope skills (unless `include_account` is false) plus the caller's team skills
- `account`: account-scope skills only (`team_id` = 0)
- `team`: the caller's team skills only

query.description: Free-text search across skill name, description, English description, skill ID, marketplace source template name, and author.

team_ids.description: Limit team-scope results to these team IDs; IDs of teams the caller does not belong to are dropped. Empty = all of the caller's teams.

include_account.description: Include account-scoped (team_id=0) rows. Defaults to true. Ignored when `scope` is `account` or `team`.

skill_id.description: Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.
Target skill ID, from the list returned by `POST /safari/skill/list`.

description.description: New description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Sending an empty string leaves the current value unchanged — there is no way to clear it via this field.

description_en.description: New English description. Cannot contain `<` or `>`. Omit to leave unchanged; send an empty string to explicitly clear it.

team_id.description: Reassign team scope: 0 = account-wide; >0 = team. Omit to leave unchanged.

SkillUploadRequest.description: Multipart form for uploading a skill archive.

file.description: Skill archive (`.skill`, `.zip`, `.tar.gz`, or `.tgz`), up to 100 MB, containing `SKILL.md` at its root or inside a single top-level folder.

team_id.description: Scope for the created or overwritten-by-name skill: 0 = account scope (default), >0 = that team. Ignored when `replace=true` and `skill_id` are both set.

replace.description: When true, overwrite an existing skill instead of failing on a name clash: the skill given by `skill_id`, or else the same-named skill in `team_id`. Accepts `true`, `1`, `yes`, `on` (case-insensitive); anything else is false.

skill_id.description: ID of the skill to overwrite, from `POST /safari/skill/list`. Used only together with `replace=true`; ignored otherwise.

KnowledgePackItem.description: Knowledge — a versioned file tree staged into every AI SRE sandbox at session start. One knowledge exists per (account, scope, scope_id).

scope.description:
Knowledge scope.
- `account`: account-level knowledge shared by the whole account; `scope_id` is the account ID.
- `team`: knowledge owned by one team; `scope_id` is the team ID.
- `channel`: legacy scope. It cannot be created or moved into through this API and is never returned by `POST /safari/knowledge/pack/list`; it can only appear when such knowledge is addressed directly by `pack_id`.

scope_id.description: Scope owner: the account ID for `account` scope, the team ID for `team` scope.

team_name.description: Display name of the owning team (team scope only). Omitted when empty (account scope, or the team name could not be resolved).

file_count.description: Number of files currently in the knowledge.

total_bytes.description: Total size of all files in bytes. Capped at 5 MiB per knowledge.

version.description: Knowledge version. Starts at 0 and increases by 1 on every file write or file deletion. Moving the knowledge to another scope does not change it.

duty_version.description: The `version` at which `DUTY.md` was last written. Writing `DUTY.md` sets it to the new `version`; when `version` is greater, files were added, changed or deleted after `DUTY.md` was last updated, so `DUTY.md` may no longer index every file.

created_by.description: Person ID of the member whose request created the knowledge. Account knowledge is created automatically by the first request that needs it, so this can be any member of the account.

created_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the knowledge was created.

updated_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the knowledge was last modified.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller can change this knowledge and its files: for `account` scope, `true` only for the account owner and admins; for `team` scope, `true` only when the caller is a member of that team (owners and admins are not exempt).

KnowledgeFileItem.description: Metadata of one knowledge file. Content is fetched separately via file/get.

pack_id.description: ID of the knowledge that contains the file.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the knowledge root, using `/` separators, e.g. `runbooks/restart.md`. Unique within the knowledge.

content_type.description: MIME type stored with the file. Open set: when `content_type` is omitted on write it is derived from the extension of `rel_path` — `.md` → `text/markdown`, `.yaml`/`.yml` → `text/yaml`, `.json` → `application/json`, `.sh` → `text/x-sh`, anything else → `text/plain`; a value passed explicitly is stored as given.

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the file content.

updated_by.description: Person ID of the member who last modified the file.

updated_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the file was last modified.

KnowledgeWarning.description: Non-blocking annotation returned by file uploads and deletions, e.g. references that point at a removed file.

code.description: Warning code. One of: `unresolved_reference` (an @ref in the written file's content points to a file that does not exist in the knowledge; `ref` carries it), `still_referenced_by` (the deleted file is still @ref-referenced by other files in the knowledge; `refs` lists the referrers).

ref.description: Set only for `unresolved_reference`: the referenced path that does not exist in the knowledge.

refs.description: Set only for `still_referenced_by`: `rel_path` of every other file that still references the deleted file.

KnowledgeGetRequest.description: No request fields — the account-scope knowledge is always targeted.

KnowledgePackListRequest.description: Filter and pagination for the knowledge list.

p.description: Page number, 1-based. When both `p` and `limit` are omitted (or ≤ 0), all matching knowledge is returned without paging; when only `limit` is set, `p` defaults to 1.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 20 when `p` is set and `limit` is omitted; no upper bound is enforced.

scope.description:
Which scopes to return:
- `all` (default): account knowledge (unless `include_account` is `false`) plus the visible team knowledge.
- `account`: only the account knowledge; `include_account` and `team_ids` are ignored.
- `team`: only team knowledge, optionally narrowed by `team_ids`; `include_account` is ignored.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter over knowledge ID, scope, scope ID, account ID and team name. Account knowledge also matches `账户`/`账号` and team knowledge also matches `团队`. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored.

team_ids.description: Restrict team knowledge to these team IDs. IDs of teams the caller does not belong to are silently dropped — this applies to every caller, including owners and admins.

include_account.description: Whether to include the account knowledge when `scope` is `all` or omitted. Defaults to `true`.

KnowledgePackEnsureRequest.description: Scope at which to ensure knowledge exists.

scope.description:
Scope of the knowledge to ensure.
- `account`: the account knowledge. `scope_id` is replaced by the caller's account ID; only the account owner and admins may call this, even when the knowledge already exists. If the knowledge has no `DUTY.md`, a default one is written.
- `team`: the knowledge of the team in `scope_id`. `scope_id` is required and the caller must be a member of that team.

scope_id.description: Team ID. Required (non-zero) for `team` scope, otherwise the request fails with `InvalidParameter`; ignored for `account` scope.

KnowledgePackUpdateRequest.description: Move knowledge to a different scope.

scope.description:
Destination scope. Omit to leave the knowledge unchanged and get it back.
- `account`: make it the account knowledge (only the account owner and admins).
- `team`: move it to the team in `scope_id` (the caller must be a member of that team).
Any other value returns `InvalidParameter`. If the destination already has knowledge, the request fails with `ReferenceExist`.

scope_id.description: Destination team ID. Required (non-zero) when `scope` is `team`; ignored when `scope` is `account` (the account ID is used).

ok.description: Always `true` on success; a failed delete returns an error instead.

pack_id.description: Knowledge ID; defaults to the caller's account-scope knowledge.

p.description: Page number, 1-based. Accepted but currently ignored — the response always contains the full file list.

limit.description: Page size. Accepted but currently ignored — the response always contains the full file list.

pack_id.description: Knowledge ID; defaults to the caller's account-scope knowledge.

rel_path.description: Path of the file relative to the knowledge root. If no file exists at this path, the call still succeeds with `file` set to `null` and an empty `content_b64`.

KnowledgeFilePutRequest.description: File to create or overwrite. The body is base64 text in `content_b64`, not a multipart upload.

pack_id.description: Knowledge ID; defaults to the caller's account-scope knowledge.

rel_path.description: Destination path relative to the knowledge root; an existing file at this path is overwritten. Must use `/` separators, must not start with `/`, must already be in normalized form, and no segment may be empty, `.`, `..`, or start with `.` (dotfiles are rejected).

content_b64.description: Base64-encoded (standard alphabet) file content. The decoded bytes must be UTF-8 text with no NUL bytes and at most 1 MiB (`DUTY.md`: at most 32 KiB). Omit or send an empty string to write an empty file.

content_type.description: MIME type to store with the file. Optional: when omitted it is derived from the extension of `rel_path` (`.md` → `text/markdown`, `.yaml`/`.yml` → `text/yaml`, `.json` → `application/json`, `.sh` → `text/x-sh`, otherwise `text/plain`). Any value passed is stored as given.

expected_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard. `0` or omitted: write unconditionally. A positive value: write only if the knowledge's current `version` equals it; otherwise nothing is written and the call returns HTTP 200 with `status` = `conflict` and the current `version`.

KnowledgeGetResponse.description: Account-scope knowledge metadata plus its file list.

files.description: Array of files in this knowledge; empty array when it has no files.

KnowledgePackListResponse.description: Visible knowledge and the total after filtering.

packs.description: Array of visible knowledge after filtering (current page), used with `total` for pagination.

total.description: Total number of knowledge entries after filtering, before pagination.

KnowledgeFileListResponse.description: All files in the knowledge plus the current knowledge version.

files.description: Array of files in the specified knowledge; empty array when it has no files.

total.description: Number of files in `files` — always the full file count of the knowledge, since this endpoint does not paginate.

version.description: Current `version` of the knowledge; usable as `expected_version` for file writes.

KnowledgeFileGetResponse.description: File metadata, its base64-encoded content, and the current knowledge version.

file.description: Metadata of the file; `null` when no file exists at `rel_path`.

content_b64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Empty string when the file does not exist (or is empty).

version.description: Current `version` of the knowledge. Pass it as `expected_version` to `POST /safari/knowledge/file/put` or `POST /safari/knowledge/file/delete` to reject the write if someone else changed the knowledge in between.

KnowledgeFilePutResponse.description: Write result. On success carries the written file; on a version conflict carries only `status`, `version` and `message`.

status.description:
Outcome of the write.
- `ok`: the change was committed.
- `conflict`: `expected_version` did not match the current knowledge version, so nothing was changed; re-read the file and retry with the returned `version`.

file.description: The file as stored after the write. Omitted when `status` is `conflict`.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings; `unresolved_reference` means an @ref in the written content points to a path that does not exist in the knowledge. Omitted when there are no warnings.

version.description: Knowledge `version` produced by this write when `status` is `ok`; the current version when `status` is `conflict`. Use it as `expected_version` for the next write.

message.description: Explanation of the conflict (`this knowledge was updated by someone else`). Present only when `status` is `conflict`.

pack_id.description: Knowledge ID; defaults to the caller's account-scope knowledge.

rel_path.description: Path of the file relative to the knowledge root. Same path rules as `POST /safari/knowledge/file/put`.

force.description: Delete even when other knowledge files reference this file; the referrers are then returned as warnings instead of blocking the delete.

expected_version.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard. `0` or omitted: delete unconditionally. A positive value: delete only if the knowledge's current `version` equals it; otherwise nothing is deleted and the call returns HTTP 200 with `status` = `conflict` and the current `version`.

status.description:
Outcome of the delete.
- `ok`: the file was deleted, or did not exist.
- `conflict`: `expected_version` did not match the current knowledge version, so nothing was deleted.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings; `still_referenced_by` means `force` deleted a file that other files still reference (`refs` lists them). Omitted when there are no warnings.

version.description: Knowledge `version` after the delete (unchanged if the file did not exist). When the file did not exist and `expected_version` was not sent, this is `0`. On `conflict`, the current version.

message.description: Explanation of the conflict. Present only when `status` is `conflict`.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

ArtifactListRequest.description: Filter and paginate the artifact gallery.

scope.description: Visibility scope. `all` (default) lists the caller's own personal artifacts plus artifacts of every team the caller belongs to; `personal` lists only the caller's own; `team` lists only team-owned artifacts of the caller's teams.

team_ids.description: Restrict to artifacts owned by these team IDs, intersected with the `scope` filter. Non-positive IDs are ignored; teams the caller does not belong to return nothing, and personal artifacts are excluded whenever this is set.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the artifact title.

page.description: Page number, 1-based. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

limit.description: Number of artifacts per page. Values below 1 fall back to 20; values above 100 are capped at 100 (not rejected).

orderby.description: Sort field: `created_at` (publish time) or `updated_at` (last change). Empty sorts by `updated_at` descending. In every case the caller's pinned artifacts come first, and `artifact_id` breaks ties.

asc.description: Sort ascending when true, descending when false. Applies only when `orderby` is set.

items.description: Artifacts on this page; the caller's pinned artifacts come first. An empty array when nothing matches.

total.description: Total number of artifacts matching the filter across all pages.

PublishedArtifactItem.description: One published artifact in the gallery. Time fields are Unix timestamps in milliseconds.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

team_id.description: Owning scope. `0` means a personal artifact: it appears only in its creator's list, and can be managed by the creator or by anyone who can manage the source session. A positive value is the owning team ID: the artifact appears in that team's members' lists and any team member can manage it. Set from the source session at first publish; change it with `/safari/artifact/gallery/update`.

team_name.description: Owning team's display name. Omitted for personal artifacts.

person_id.description: Person ID of the artifact's creator: the owner of the source session at first publish. It never changes on republish or scope transfer.

is_mine.description: `true` when the caller (for an `app_key` call, the key owner) is the creator, i.e. `person_id` equals the caller's person ID.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may manage this artifact (rename, transfer, delete, share): the creator, any member of the owning team, or a manager of the source session.

session_id.description: Source session ID (`sess_` prefix) that produced the file.

session_title.description: Source session's title. Omitted when the session has been deleted.

file_id.description: Presented-file ID (`pf_` prefix) currently holding the artifact's bytes. Changes on every republish.

name.description: Underlying file name including extension. Empty when the underlying file record is missing.

content_type.description: MIME type, derived from the file-name extension when the file was produced: `text/html` (.html/.htm), `text/markdown` (.md), `text/plain` (.txt/.log), `text/csv`, `text/yaml` (.yaml/.yml), `text/x-python`, `text/x-go`, `text/x-sh`, `application/json`, `application/xml`, `application/pdf`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/svg+xml`, `image/webp`, `application/zip`, `application/gzip` (.tar/.gz/.tgz); any other extension is `application/octet-stream`. Empty when the underlying file record is missing.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the artifact was published.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last change to the artifact row (rename, transfer, republish, or share state change).

pinned_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the caller pinned this artifact in the console gallery. Pins are per member; omitted when the caller has not pinned it. Pinned artifacts are listed first by `/safari/artifact/gallery/list`.

share_enabled.description: Whether anonymous public sharing is on. Omitted when false.

public_url.description: Anonymous public link — a console `/share/artifact/<artifact_id>` page served entirely from CDN. Present only while shared; anyone with the link can view it, no login required.

shared_by.description: Person ID of the member who enabled sharing; a later snapshot sync does not change it. Present only while shared.

shared_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last share enable or snapshot sync. Present only while shared.

share_file_id.description: Presented-file ID the public snapshot was materialized from. When `share_enabled` is true and `file_id` differs from `share_file_id`, the public snapshot is stale — call `/safari/artifact/gallery/share/sync` to refresh it.

ArtifactUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of a gallery artifact. Only provided fields change.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

title.description: New title. Leading and trailing spaces are trimmed; a blank value fails with `InvalidParameter`. Omit or send `null` to keep the current title.

team_id.description: Transfer target. `0` moves the artifact to personal scope and only its creator may do that; a positive value moves it to that team, and the caller must be a member of the team; a negative value fails with `InvalidParameter`. Omit or send `null` to keep the current scope. The creator (`person_id`) never changes.

ArtifactPublishFromFileRequest.description: Publish a session-produced file to the artifact gallery.

file_id.description: Presented-file ID (`pf_` prefix) of a file produced in a session, as shown on the file card in chat.

title.description: Gallery display title. Trimmed; must be non-empty.

ArtifactPublishResponse.description: Result of publishing a file to the gallery.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

gallery_path.description: Console-relative path of the artifact page: `/ai-sre/artifacts/<artifact_id>`.

ArtifactFileStateRequest.description: Probe publish state for a batch of presented files.

file_ids.description: Presented-file IDs (`pf_` prefix) to check. At most 50 entries per call, counted before duplicates and empty strings are removed; more fails with `InvalidParameter`.

ArtifactFileStateItem.description: Live gallery state of one presented file. Matched by the file's source session and workspace path, so an older version of a republished file also reports the current artifact.

file_id.description: The requested presented-file ID this entry answers for.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

title.description: Gallery display title of the published artifact.

gallery_path.description: Console-relative path of the artifact page: `/ai-sre/artifacts/<artifact_id>`.

items.description: One entry per requested file whose session file path currently has a live gallery artifact; files without one, and unknown IDs, are omitted. An empty array when none match.

artifact_id.description: Artifact ID (`art_` prefix). Also the key of the public-share link.

public_url.description: Anonymous public link, `<console origin>/share/artifact/<artifact_id>`. Anyone with the link can view the content without signing in. The link is the same on every enable.

shared_by.description: Person ID of the member who enabled sharing. A snapshot sync keeps the original value.

shared_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last share enable or snapshot sync.

ArtifactSignRequest.description: Request signed download/preview URLs for a presented file.

share_token.description: Optional session share-link token. Needed only when the caller reaches the file through a shared session link rather than account membership.

SignedURLs.description: Short-lived signed URLs for downloading or previewing a file.

download_url.description: Relative URL (`/safari/artifact/stream?...`) that serves the file as an attachment. Prepend the API base `https://api.flashcat.cloud` before use; expires with `expires_in`.

preview_url.description: Same as `download_url` but served inline for browser preview.

expires_in.description: Validity of both URLs in seconds. Always `300`.

frame_url.description: Sandboxed iframe URL (`/safari/artifact/f/<token>/<file name>`) that serves this file for an embedded preview. The token in the path is its only credential; it expires with `frame_expires_in`.

frame_base.description: Frame URL directory of this artifact version, ending with `/`; append a file's relative path to load any file of a multi-file version. Empty, and therefore omitted, for single-object rows, whose frame route resolves only the file's own name.

frame_expires_in.description: Validity of `frame_url` and `frame_base` in seconds. Always `43200` (12 hours).

content_type.description: MIME type, derived from the file-name extension when the file was produced: `text/html` (.html/.htm), `text/markdown` (.md), `text/plain` (.txt/.log), `text/csv`, `text/yaml` (.yaml/.yml), `text/x-python`, `text/x-go`, `text/x-sh`, `application/json`, `application/xml`, `application/pdf`, `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/gif`, `image/svg+xml`, `image/webp`, `application/zip`, `application/gzip` (.tar/.gz/.tgz); any other extension is `application/octet-stream`.
